nodes.title: JDK HttpServer: HttpExchange.setAttribute is shared per HttpContext, not per request (session leak)
nodes.summary: In com.sun.net.httpserver, HttpExchange.getAttribute/setAttribute delegate to the HttpContext's attribute map, so a value a Filter stores (e.g. the signed-in session) is visible to every other request on the same route. Using it for auth made anonymous visitors appear signed in as the last user.
nodes.detail: Found in lynxgwas-server by an end-to-end test (logout appeared not to work: /api/auth/me still reported signed_in with no cookie). Fix: keep per-request state in a ConcurrentHashMap<HttpExchange, RequestInfo> keyed by the exchange object (identity equality), put in the Filter's doFilter and removed in finally; handlers look it up with the exchange. Also read the user id in the request thread before handing work to background threads. Regression test: after user A signs in, an anonymous request on the same route must still be anonymous.
nodes.trigger: Writing a com.sun.net.httpserver Filter that authenticates requests and passes the user/session to handlers via HttpExchange attributes

nodes.title: Ship a Java server with no JDK/JRE install: cross-platform jlink bundle with launcher
nodes.summary: When the target machine cannot install Java, build a trimmed runtime with jlink (modules from jdeps --print-module-deps plus service providers jdeps misses, e.g. jdk.crypto.ec for TLS/SMTP) and ship it next to the app with a launcher script that uses runtime/bin/java. For another OS, point jlink at that OS's JDK jmods of the exact same version (e.g. Microsoft/Temurin 17.0.10 linux-x64 tarball when building on Windows).
nodes.detail: lynxgwas-server/scripts/package-server.sh: jlink --module-path <targetJDK>/jmods --add-modules <list> --strip-debug --no-man-pages --no-header-files --compress=2 --output runtime; result ~45-55 MB runtime, ~45 MB tar.gz. On Windows Git Bash, calling build.bat via cmd.exe needs MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 and '.\\build.bat' (NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath is set, so bare 'build.bat' is 'not recognized').
